verdict.rationale: Square AI (Beta) is a documented in-product assistant that answers natural-language questions over the seller's own sales and inventory data. Square says it can 'pull game-changing insights from your data', and vendor-hosted testimonials describe analyzing best-selling items and plotting product contribution over time. Separately, Square's ML fraud tooling surfaces 'insights into payment fraud patterns'. missing for 10: proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations are not explicitly documented, the assistant is still Beta, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
